## ROLEPLAY RULE 4. You are expected to roleplay without breaking immersion.
- Don’t mention out-of-character (OOC) concepts like admins, developers, bans, or keybinds in-character (IC). You may refer to these things with roleplay terms (such as gods or other creative comparisons). - Don’t use emotes to bypass muted or accented speech, and do not use unbelievable or impossible emotes. - Don’t talk about real world celebrities, events, politics, wars or controversy and unrelated sensitive topics. - Don’t use netspeak, such as messaging acronyms (ex: "lol", "wtf", "brb", "lmao", "thx", "sgtm") or emoticons (ex: ":)", "xD") in-character. - Your in-character speech mannerisms should remain believable and not break immersion. Don’t use memes or inane online references. (ex: "chud", "67", "skibidi", "rizz", "sigma", "omegalul"). - Don’t name your character after a celebrity, or as a reference to anything mentioned above. Pick a believable name. Don’t use titles/honorifics in your name, unless it’s a stage name while you are playing as an entertainer (which includes clown, musician, boxer or mime.)
